summary: Frontend performance + regression verification after code-splitting / font preload / image resize optimizations. Load times are excellent on both mobile (390x844) and tablet (768x1024). All lazy sections mount, no horizontal scroll on any tested width, mobile menu + tablet nav + project modal (mouse close + Escape) all working, resume PDF + image + LegalFormat link all correct (HTTP 200). No console errors from Suspense fallback.

performance_metrics.verdict: Excellent. FCP well under 1s on mobile and tablet; hero visible sub-second. Code-splitting effective.

critical_code_review_comments: Performance optimizations are effective: FCP 500ms mobile / 704ms tablet, main chunk reduced. No further action needed for the reported slow-load issue on preview.
Suggest also adding width/height attributes on hero to reserve layout space (CLS) if not already.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Portfolio SPA at REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Below-the-fold sections are React.lazy — always wait ~2s or scroll to section before asserting on their DOM. Modal close-button visibility check right after mouse click can race; poll for element removal instead of a single is_visible call.
